envelope.description: Test-file naming for a project with a repo setting (plan-level addition)

body.title: Test-file naming for a project with a repo setting (plan-level addition)
body.summary: Plan-level addition for the user to confirm at approval, not in the LLD: test-mapping refuses a case file not ending in .test.ts and the trivial plan's isTest keeps only .test.ts files in __tests__. For a plan with commandsSource 'repo-setting' and a non-Node type, accept any repo-relative file for a case and treat the project's own test files as tests, leaving the Node rules unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: A Node plan still refuses a case file that is not .test.ts
A repo-setting python or go plan accepts its own test file path as a case
The trivial plan's isTest does not drop non-Node test files for such a plan

tests.name: src/daemon/steps/build-step/__tests__/test-mapping.test.ts: a Node plan refuses a case file that is not .test.ts and a repo-setting plan accepts its own test file
